title: Does Ayushman Bharat Cover Joint Replacement at Silver Touch Hospitals?
seoTitle: Does Ayushman Bharat Cover Joint Replacement at Silver Touch Hospitals?
description: Discover cashless knee and hip replacement surgery under Ayushman Bharat at Silver Touch Hospitals. Quality orthopedic care with no financial burden.

image.alt: Does Ayushman Bharat Cover Joint Replacement at Silver Touch Hospitals?

html:
Living with severe knee or hip pain makes life very hard. Simple tasks like walking to the local market, climbing stairs, or playing with your grandchildren become almost impossible. When medicines and exercises stop working, a joint operation is often the only way to get your normal life back.

However, many families worry deeply about the treatment costs. If you are looking for an affordable joint replacement hospital in Ahmedabad, understanding your insurance options can save you from big financial worries.

The good news is that you do not have to delay your treatment due to money. Silver Touch Hospitals is a fully empaneled PMJAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana) hospital, which is commonly known as the Ayushman Bharat scheme. This means eligible families can receive quality healthcare without paying cash out of their pockets.

How Does the Ayushman Bharat Cover Work?

The Ayushman Bharat scheme provides a health cover of up to 5 Lakh rupees per family every year for secondary and tertiary care. Under this government program, total knee replacements and hip replacements are completely covered.

When you choose to have your treatment at our center, the scheme takes care of almost all major expenses. This includes the cost of your pre-surgery medical tests, the orthopedic surgeon’s fees, the operating theater charges, the intensive care unit (ICU) stay, and the medical implants used during the surgery.

Getting Top-Quality Treatment with Zero Cash Stress

Families may fear getting cheap materials when receiving affordable treatment. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we adhere to ethical standards in the medical field. We have experienced orthopedic specialists who always install high-quality, durable implants that ensure smooth movements.

We provide the exact same high standard of care, advanced medical technology, and clean operating theaters to every single patient, whether they are using a government card or paying privately. Our in-house team of expert physiotherapists also helps you stand and take your first steps safely within 24 hours after your operation.

Visit Our Ahmedabad Branches Today

These benefits in cashless form will be provided to you readily by our highly equipped branches situated in Satellite and Nirnay Nagar. If you possess an Ayushman card, please carry it along with all your other identification documents, such as Aadhaar card and X-ray reports of your knees.

Our dedicated hospital helpdesk will check your card eligibility and handle all the government paperwork for you. Finding a trusted, affordable joint replacement hospital in Ahmedabad does not mean you have to compromise on your health. Contact the administrative team at Silver Touch Hospitals today to understand how to use your health card and take your first step toward a pain-free life.
